key_insight: System-prompt optimization can significantly improve multi-agent LLM systems, but the benefit depends strongly on task, workflow, communication protocol, and team size.
engineering_relevance: For builders of agentic AI, system prompts are a practical optimization lever that can boost system performance without model finetuning, but they must be tuned per MAS configuration.
method: Benchmarked prompt optimization across many multi-agent system setups.
Varied task, workflow, communication protocol, and team size to test sensitivity.
Compared two prompt optimizers adapted from state-of-the-art single-agent methods.
evidence_signal: The study systematically evaluates prompt-optimized MAS across a broad range of configurations and reports that gains can be substantial, though not uniform.
watch_item: The search space grows rapidly with more agents and system components, so optimization can be expensive and may not transfer cleanly across MAS designs.
paper_title: MAS-PromptBench: When Does Prompt Optimization Improve Multi-Agent LLM Systems?
